operations.name: Saw Cut Gear Blanks
operations.setup_note: Saw 36 mm round bar into individual blanks with axial facing allowance. The production order will be processed as repeated bar batches.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First Soft Setup
operations.setup_note: Grip the sawn blank in production soft jaws and establish the first axial face. Machine the blank OD and through-bore while the material remains ferritic-pearlitic, leaving post-heat-treatment stock on the bore and faces.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second Soft Setup
operations.setup_note: Reverse the blank in soft jaws, locate from the machined OD and provisional bore axis, and face the second side. Complete the opposite bore-end details and face groove while retaining hard-finishing allowance on the axial face.

operations.name: Finish Blank Inspection Gate
operations.setup_note: Inspect the completed soft gear blank from provisional datum A before tooth cutting. Check blank OD, bore, face flatness, width, and face parallelism.

operations.name: Hob Helical Gear Teeth
operations.setup_note: Mount the inspected blank on a bore-locating production arbor with an axial face stop. Hob the 17-tooth right-hand helical profile concentric with provisional datum A, leaving shaving stock on the flanks.

operations.name: Gear Shaving and Crowning
operations.setup_note: Locate the soft gear from its bore and axial face. Shave the tooth flanks to the specified profile and longitudinal crowning before carburizing.

operations.name: Pre-Heat-Treatment Inspection Gate
operations.setup_note: Perform the required floor inspection immediately after shaving. Verify tooth span or measurement over balls and confirm the bore and blank dimensions before furnace release.

operations.name: Pre-Heat-Treatment Deburr
operations.setup_note: Bench-deburr the soft gear before carburizing, removing hobbing and shaving burrs without completing the separately required post-heat-treatment tooth chamfer. Verify that no raised material remains at tooth roots or bore edges.

operations.name: Pre-Heat-Treatment Cleaning
operations.setup_note: Wash, degrease, and completely dry the soft gears before furnace loading. Handle cleaned parts to prevent recontamination of surfaces intended for carburizing.

operations.name: Carburize, Quench and Temper
operations.setup_note: Fixture the gears for controlled distortion and process them in validated furnace batches; the 100000-piece order exceeds a single furnace load. Carburize to the specified effective case depth, quench, and temper to the drawing hardness requirements.

operations.name: Post-Heat-Treatment Teeth Chamfering
operations.setup_note: Locate the hardened gear from datum A and both axial sides using dedicated tooth-chamfer tooling. Chamfer the tooth end faces and tip edges to produce the specified maximum edge modification before blasting.

operations.name: Post-Heat-Treatment Shot Blast
operations.setup_note: Shot blast the hardened gears after tooth chamfering to remove heat-treatment scale and residue. Use controlled media and exposure to avoid damaging the tooth profile or precision bore allowance.

operations.name: Heat-Treatment Verification
operations.setup_note: Verify surface hardness, effective case depth on representative coupons, core hardness at the tooth root, and heat-treatment distortion before hard finishing. Release only conforming furnace batches.

operations.name: CNC Hard Turn – Bore and First Face
operations.setup_note: Grip the hardened gear on controlled tooth-compatible soft jaws and pick up the existing bore axis. Hard-finish the through-bore and first axial face only, leaving the final honing allowance in the bore.

operations.name: CNC Hard Turn – Second Face
operations.setup_note: Reverse the hardened gear onto an expanding mandrel located by the hard-finished bore. Hard-turn the opposite face to final width and runout relative to datum A; do not hard-turn any OD surface.

operations.name: Final Bore Honing
operations.setup_note: Locate and support the hardened gear in a low-distortion honing fixture. Hone datum bore A to final diameter, cylindricity, and specified plateau surface parameters; no later operation may cut the bore.

operations.name: Post-Heat-Treatment OD Cylindrical Grinding
operations.setup_note: Mount the hardened gear on a precision expanding mandrel located by final datum bore A and reference an axial face. Cylindrically grind the applicable external cylindrical surface without hard turning it.

operations.name: Final Washing and Dry Protection
operations.setup_note: Wash the gears after hard turning, honing, and OD grinding to remove cutting oil, abrasive residue, and hardened swarf. Dry the parts, apply the required temporary corrosion protection, and maintain the specified technical cleanliness.

operations.name: Final Dimensional and Gear Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect the stabilized, clean gear from final datum bore A and an axial face. Verify bore size and cylindricity, face runout, width, external dimensions, tooth profile and lead, pitch, radial runout, measurement over balls, surface texture, and cleanliness.

clarifications.question: Is F01 an accessible continuous cylindrical land that can be OD ground rather than the interrupted tooth-root diameter?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat F01 as an accessible cylindrical surface and retain the required post-heat-treatment OD grinding operation.

clarifications.question: May the approved gear_hobbing machine-family key be used for the dedicated post-heat-treatment teeth-chamfering station?
clarifications.suggested_default: Use gear_hobbing as the nearest approved controlled machine-family key with dedicated tooth-chamfer tooling.

clarifications.question: Is post-heat-treatment tooth grinding intentionally omitted for this DIN 8 gear after shaving and controlled carburizing?
clarifications.suggested_default: Assume the specified DIN 8 and Rz 6 tooth requirements are achieved by shaving plus controlled heat treatment, with no hard tooth grinding or honing.

assumptions.text: Round bar was selected per GEAR-008 because the drawing does not specify a forging or directional grain-flow requirement; 36 mm diameter by 41 mm long provides the prescribed turning and facing allowances.
F01 is routed through hobbing as part of the generated tooth-root geometry and through OD grinding per GEAR-007; its accessibility for cylindrical grinding requires confirmation.
Pre-heat-treatment gear shaving is treated as the final tooth-flank sizing process because the drawing specifies DIN 8 and Rz 6 but does not explicitly require hard gear grinding or teeth honing.
Post-heat-treatment hard face turning replaces the template face-grinding step and is assumed capable of meeting the 0.03 mm face runout controls; GEAR-007 prohibits hard turning of the OD.

Hard finish boring followed by honing is assumed sufficient to remove bore distortion. ID grinding is omitted because the expected residual distortion is assumed to remain within hard-turning and honing capability.

The face grooves, bore tapers, and bore chamfers are completed before heat treatment with process compensation for subsequent face-stock removal because GEAR-007 restricts post-heat-treatment CNC turning to finish-bore and face-turn sub-operations.

Center drilling, threading, and part-off were omitted because the component has a low length-to-diameter ratio, no threads, and is produced from individually sawn blanks rather than parted from a bar-fed turning cycle.

Selective carburizing masking, quench straightening, and separate stress relieving were omitted because no soft-zone requirement is shown and the compact gear is not a long shaft; controlled furnace fixturing is assumed to limit distortion.

Lapping, superfinishing, hard tooth grinding, and tooth honing were omitted because no ultra-fine finish or higher gear accuracy class requiring those conditional template steps is explicitly specified.
The correction's cylindrical_grinder designation was mapped to the shop's exact approved machine-family key od_grinding.

The standalone final washing operation is placed after all hard finishing, including OD grinding, so it remains after CNC hard turning and before final inspection while also satisfying the GEAR-007 sequence.
